text: Simple illustration of A close-up of a face seen through fractured transparent grass panes. Each grass leaf catches a different color of faint lavender light, refracting her expression into splintered serenity. The background is pure shadow, with reflections hovering like spirits around her. The glass is both her veil and her echo.( ringed golden eyes) Color tension: lavender frost × obsidian black x green vibrance Mood: reflection within silence Visual technique: refracted focus, specular bloom, layered transparency
